midgame_rebalance_energy_success.patch_note: New unlocks receive a larger initial improvement before settling toward these average values. Patch targeted gathering consistency rather than publishing a new XP/h table.

methods.method: Memorial to Guthix engrams + boon pipeline
methods.level_range: 1–99 (engrams scale with energy tier; prestige from 80+ with high energy access)
methods.xp_rate: not a continuous XP/h method; one-time/prestige energy sinks that permanently buff Divination training
methods.intensity: planning + energy banking while training elsewhere
methods.location: Memorial to Guthix / Piscatoris Hunter area (Hall of Memories pool beneath)
methods.notes: Ironman/League priority: bank energy for the next boon and the matching engram while at each colony. Prestige costs scale per engram (Pale through Incandescent). Time-Worn Memories (Elder Sword engram, unlockable from 10 Div) is the Daemonheim 4x convert key. Ethereal Connection (World Gate engram) extends spring duration by 30s including Daemonheim springs. Abyssal Transit (60+) doubles chronicle empower charge. Aagi Hall bot unlocks a second active Memorial buff slot.
methods.warning: Do not treat engram charging as primary XP; it is permanent unlock infrastructure for all other Divination methods.

methods.level_range: 10–85+ practical; strongest with 85+ lustrous/brilliant/radiant dungeon wisps

xp_rate.solo_with_boosts_wiki: 350,000–500,000 Divination XP/h depending on wisp generation and floor completion speed
xp_rate.elite_team_large_floors_wiki: can exceed 1,000,000 Divination XP/h on 5–10 minute large floors

methods.intensity: active floors; 2-tick springs is click-intensive but lengthens AFK deposit windows
methods.location: Daemonheim (Forinthry/Wilderness elective; Equilibrium hard-maps Daemonheim to forinthry)
methods.notes: Unlock Time-Worn Memories via Elder Sword engram at Memorial to Guthix (available from 10 Div) — quadruples Divination XP from converting memories inside Daemonheim. Memories stack in inventory so convert rate beats surface for many setups. Stack: Ethereal Connection (longer springs, multiplayer spring extension), Scroll of gathering (80k DG tokens, +25% skilling XP in Daemonheim including Divination), Ring of Kinship gatherer upgrades, multi-player spring duration, 2-tick springs. Prefer lustrous/brilliant/radiant dungeon wisps at 85+. Also awards Dungeoneering XP. Boons do not apply in Daemonheim.
methods.warning: Rates depend on party speed and wisp rolls; not a fixed table. Requires Forinthry for Daemonheim access in Equilibrium. Scroll of gathering is a permanent Dungeoneering token unlock.

methods.level_range: 31+ Divination for cobalt; higher tiers scale to crystal (71 Div / 97 Hunter catch)
methods.xp_rate: not a standalone method; +10% base XP on successful Divination actions and 5% of a success on failed harvest attempts; +3%–22.5% enriched/critical chance by tier
methods.intensity: passive consumable while training any wisp or Hall method
methods.location: Wielded or in backpack while training Divination; caught via Hunter box traps / Manor Farm produce
methods.notes: Applies to Divination gathering: one skillchompa consumed per XP grant. Tiers (Div increase / crit): cobalt 3%, viridian 6%, azure 10%, crimson 15%, crystal 22.5%. Does not need to be wielded if in backpack (wielded takes priority). Multiplies with other base-XP and crit stacking (outfits, Memory Overflow, enriched springs). Supply cost is Hunter/farming gated in no-trade League — budget skillchompas as a Divination intensity/cost lever, not free XP.
methods.warning: Do not treat skillchompas as a separate XP source; fold them into colony/HoM/Incandescent intensity notes when costing a route.

methods.method: Amlodd worker energy pickpocket (Memorial prestige support)
methods.level_range: Prifddinas access; 94 Thieving for Amlodd workers; Memorial prestige relevant from ~80 Divination
methods.xp_rate: no reliable Divination XP/h (Thieving XP method that yields Radiant / Luminous / Incandescent energy for Memorial prestige and product stock)
methods.intensity: active pickpocketing (Thieving route with Divination logistics value)
methods.notes: Ironman Divination guide: with Prifddinas and 94 Thieving, pickpocket Amlodd workers for Radiant, Luminous, and Incandescent energy so Memorial to Guthix can be prestiged from 80 Divination without waiting on colony energy alone. Planner value is Tirannwn + high Thieving for energy/prestige acceleration, not primary Divination training XP.
methods.warning: Requires Tirannwn (Prifddinas). Do not list as a Divination XP ladder step.

methods.xp_rate: 4,700–36,700 Divination XP per 100-point cache across levels 35–99 (wiki range)
methods.intensity: short active D&D; hop quiet worlds before entry to reduce competition
methods.location: Enter via any energy rift except pale after depositing 800 memories total (player-driven; no hourly timer since March 2026 Dailyscape Overhaul)
methods.notes: Consistent burst XP and chance at Diviner's outfit pieces (including ironmen). Max 100 points per entry. Complements colony/HoM/Daemonheim ladders rather than replacing them.
methods.warning: Outfit RNG and short session length; not a continuous training method.
